Call for contributions

Would you like to help shape the EnhanceR Symposium? We are looking for contributions from a range of areas relevant to our community:

  • Show-and-tell sessions: Share software you developed, a specific project, tool or technique. These are 20 minute sessions, plus 10 minutes for set-up and discussions.
  • Workshops: Lead a more in-depth, hands-on session or facilitate a discussion on a topic, 45 minute sessions.

Examples for workshops include, but are not limited to:

  • Hands-on sessions focusing on specific techniques (e.g., advanced Git workflows).
  • Effective data management strategies and techniques.
  • Generative AI in RSE: practical applications and implications.
  • Implementing best practices for reproducible, ethical, inclusive, and collaborative data science and research, following principles like those championed by "The Turing Way".
  • Strategies for scaling up RSE initiatives within Switzerland.
  • Project management methodologies tailored for research software projects.
  • Navigating the role and challenges of an RSE.

Idea submission deadline has been extended to July 11th, 2025.

Please submit your idea as part of your registration.
